title: Hypothetical storage chemistry

primary.metric: net present cost versus feeder upgrade (USD)
primary.statement: IF a chemistry with 2.0x density at 0.5x cost existed, the modelled microgrid NPC ($3.0M) would be below the feeder upgrade path ($10.0M). Says nothing about whether such a device can be built.

water_within_recharge.note: not modelled: no withdrawal model in this run (cards adding water load must supply one)

no_displacement.note: no housing-cost channel in this card

worst_off_decile_must_gain.note: baseline worst-decile 0.0377 -> 0.0377 (per-seed; 90% CI checked across seeds)

political_variables_excluded.note: denylist clean on all indicator tables (files fenced at load time)

indicator_provenance.minutes_to_emergency_care: derived (OSM road graph to observed hospital; speeds assumed)
indicator_provenance.minutes_to_primary_care: derived proxy (hospital used as primary-care destination; clinic layer not fetched)
indicator_provenance.school_travel_minutes_one_way: derived (OSM road graph to observed schools)
indicator_provenance.usable_upload_mbps: assumed (uniform 0.5-25; FCC BDC layer not in pilot bundle)
indicator_provenance.usable_download_mbps: assumed (scaled from upload; FCC BDC layer not in pilot bundle)
indicator_provenance.outage_hours_per_year: assumed (rural SAIDI placeholder; EIA reliability not in bundle)
indicator_provenance.income_after_essentials: calibrated income minus assumed essentials share 0.62
indicator_provenance.detour_minutes_from_closed_or_posted_bri: derived (NBI poor bridges removed from OSM graph)
indicator_provenance.household_can_do_remote_learning: derived from assumed bandwidth (25 Mbps threshold)
